description: Create a record of the given sobject type with the given fields. Requires sobject and a non-empty fields object. This is a write action.
embedding_description: Create a new Salesforce record (e.g. a new Contact, Opportunity, or custom object row) with the supplied field values. Requires sobject (the object API name) and a non-empty fields object. A write action.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with id (the new record's id) and success (bool).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm creation and report the new record id; low sensitivity (id only, data_sensitivity 0.0).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: missing sobject or an empty/missing fields object. sf.malformed_query: a field value or combination was rejected (e.g. a required field missing, an invalid picklist value). sf.permission_denied: the CLI's authenticated user cannot create this object.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.malformed_query: check required fields and valid values via describe_sobject. sf.permission_denied: ask the operator to check create permission for this object.
